# Printed Text Stroke

Width of the thinnest stroke of printed lettering, which can fuse shut or not print.

<figure markdown="span">
![Printed Text Stroke: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-text-stroke-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Printed Text Stroke: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-printed-text-stroke-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Width of the thinnest stroke of raised or cut-in lettering.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    !!! info "Worked out at analysis time"

        Derived from nozzle diameter during DFM analysis setup. The values below are used only when there is nothing to work them out from.
    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.8 mm | 0.4 mm | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.15 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.5 mm wide engraving")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 4: 0.15 mm") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.5 mm | 0.35 mm | Aim for: Published, [Creabis](../../citations/bibliography.md#creabis-mjf "0.5 mm strokes")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "0.35 mm wide detail") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin letter strokes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}` (two extrusion widths). Strokes this thin print as a single wobbly line. Use a bolder font or larger text.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Letter strokes too thin to print (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under `{limit}` (one extrusion width). The slicer drops strokes this thin, so the lettering `{fault}`. Use a bold font or enlarge the text.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin letter strokes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Fine strokes blur as excess resin cures at their edges. Use a bolder font or larger text.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Letter strokes too thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under `{limit}`, so the lettering `{fault}`. Use a bold font or enlarge the text.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin letter strokes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Fine strokes blur in the grainy surface. Use a bolder font or larger text.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Letter strokes too thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` has `{size}`, under `{limit}`, so the lettering `{fault}`. Use a bold font or enlarge the text.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{fault}` | What happens to strokes this thin: "may not print" or "may fill in" |
